title: 第23章  卤簿求追读第24章 祭典开始月票加更
slug: 方士开局我给秦始皇画大饼
content_zh:
就在石公倍感忧虑之际，一阵轻快而有力的脚步声由远及近。
“请问，是邹大方师吗？”
只见一位少年将军，快步来到四人面前，恭敬行礼。
他头戴象征勇武的鹖冠，身着朱红色中衣，外披彩色鱼鳞细甲，甲片在灯火映照下流光溢彩，显得神采飞扬。
“足下是？”
邹云与石公迅速交换一个眼神，由他上前一步，拱手回礼。
少年将军微微一笑，露出洁白牙齿，朗声道，“臣蒙宣德，家父郎中令。”
“哦，原来是蒙将军家的公子。”
邹云恍然，心中却有些意外。
他没想到，就蒙毅那高大魁梧的粗壮模样，生的儿子竟然如此眉清目秀。
“家父有令，命我带大方师邹生，石生前往大臣座车安置。”蒙宣德清晰传达着指令。
“至于另外两位方士，请在此地稍等片刻，你们则另有安排。”
四人闻言，再次对视一眼。
心知这是卤簿既定的安排，便不再多言，各自跟随指引前往不同的位置。
时间过得很快。
当天边泛起第一缕霞光时，正阳门那巍峨箭楼上，三十六支青铜号角同时被力士吹响。
“呜——嗡——”
在无数目光的注视下，正阳门缓缓洞开，阳光自其中斜射而出。
首先涌出城门的，是一个如黑色铁流般的千骑方阵。
一面巨大的玄色将旗引领在前，后面是清一色黑甲黑盔，腰佩阔剑的秦军锐士。

他们皆面容冷峻，目光如电，直视前方。
值得注意的是，这一千骑兵竟无一人持握长戟。
这意味着他们绝不是摆排场的仪仗队，而是一支真正能随时投入战斗的精锐野战力量。
紧跟在千骑方阵之后的，是三十六面擎天巨旌组成的方阵。
旗杆高耸入云，旗帜大书“秦”字，分作黑、赤、白、青、黄五色，在初升朝阳下猎猎翻飞，色彩斑斓，气势磅礴如虹。
旗手皆是精悍的马上骑士，控马技术娴熟，确保巨旗始终高扬。
旌旗方阵之后，便是一百辆战车。
每辆战车上肃立着十名重甲步卒，人人背挎一架臂张连弩，手中握着一支两丈长的长矛。
战车方阵之后，是二十辆特制的大型座车，双车并驶，车内满满当当载着无法骑乘奔驰的官仆、宫女和内侍。
紧接着，是整个卤簿仪仗的核心。
连续九个百人骑士队，护卫着九辆皇帝御车。
每个百人骑队护一辆青铜御车，九辆车形制完全相同，均由四匹骏马牵引，没有任何差别。
除了最核心的护卫，没有人知道，此刻嬴政究竟在哪一辆车上。
九车之后，是一辆宽大精美的两马青铜轺车，八尺车盖下，肃然端坐着丞相李斯。
其后是两车并行的大臣座车，十余位朝中重臣分乘其间，邹云和石公也位于其中。
再往后，便是一个由三十六骑组成，规模稍小但同样威武的旌旗方阵。
最后压阵的，则是另一个千骑方阵，如同巨龙的尾翼，沉稳有力，确保整个队伍的后路无虞。
整支庞大的队伍，竟无一人是步行。
所有人或乘车，或骑马，在号角与旗帜的引领下，如同一头被唤醒的钢铁巨兽。
开始向着雍城的方向，滚滚前行。

这绝不止是一个祭祀的仪仗队伍，更是一个能够快速启动，快速行进的庞大战争机器。
在临近岁首的晨曦中，展现出大秦帝国无与伦比的威严与力量。
content_en:
Just when Shi Gong was feeling worried, there was a sound of brisk and powerful footsteps approaching from far away.
"Excuse me, is this Master Zou Dafang?"
I saw a young general walking quickly in front of the four people and saluting respectfully.
He wears a heguan that symbolizes bravery, a vermilion middle coat, and colorful fish scale armor. The armor is shining brightly under the light, making him look energetic.
"Who are you?"
Zou Yun and Shi Gong quickly exchanged glances, and he took a step forward and returned the favor.
The young general smiled slightly, showing his white teeth, and said loudly, "I am Xuande, and my father is the commander of the order."
"Oh, it turns out he is the son of General Meng's family."
Zou Yun suddenly realized, but felt a little surprised.
He didn't expect that despite Meng Yi's tall, burly appearance, his son would be so handsome.
"My father has an order, and he ordered me to take the great alchemist Zou Sheng and Shi Sheng to the minister's car for resettlement." Meng Xuande conveyed the order clearly.
"As for the other two alchemists, please wait here for a while, you have other arrangements."
After hearing this, the four people looked at each other again.
Knowing that this was Lu Bu's established arrangement, he stopped saying anything and followed the guidance to different locations.
Time flies.
When the first ray of light appeared in the sky, thirty-six bronze horns were blown simultaneously by powerful men on the towering archery tower of Zhengyangmen.
"Woo-buzz-"
Under the gaze of countless eyes, the Zhengyang Gate slowly opened, and the sunlight slanted out of it.
The first thing that poured out of the city gate was a phalanx of thousands of cavalry like a black iron stream.
A huge black general's flag led the way, followed by sharp soldiers of the Qin army wearing black armor, black helmets, and broad swords at their waists.
They all had stern faces and their eyes were like lightning, staring straight ahead.
It is worth noting that not one of these thousand cavalrymen holds a halberd.
This means that they are by no means a formal honor guard, but a truly elite field force that can go into battle at any time.
Immediately following the Thousand Cavalry Phalanx was a phalanx composed of thirty-six giant banners holding up the sky.
The flagpole towers into the clouds, and the flag has the Chinese character "Qin" written on it. It is divided into five colors: black, red, white, green and yellow. It is flying under the rising sun, colorful and majestic like a rainbow.
The flag bearers are all capable horsemen with skilled horse control skills, ensuring that the giant flag is always held high.
After the phalanx of flags came a hundred chariots.
Ten heavily armored infantrymen stood on each chariot, each carrying an arm-stretching crossbow on his back and holding a two-foot-long spear in his hand.
Behind the phalanx of chariots were twenty specially-made large carriages, driving side by side. The carriages were full of official servants, maids and chamberlains who were unable to ride.
Immediately afterwards, comes the core of the entire Lubu ceremony.
Nine hundred knights in a row guarded nine of the emperor's chariots.
Each hundred-man cavalry team guards a bronze royal chariot. The nine chariots are exactly the same in shape and are drawn by four horses without any difference.
Except for the core bodyguards, no one knew which car Ying Zheng was in at the moment.
After the nine carriages, there was a large and exquisite bronze carriage with two horses. Under the eight-foot hood, Prime Minister Li Si sat solemnly.
Followed by two ministerial carriages running parallel, more than ten important ministers of the court were riding in them. Zou Yun and Shi Gong were also among them.
Further behind, there is a smaller but equally powerful flag phalanx composed of thirty-six cavalry.
The last one holding the formation was another phalanx of thousands of cavalry, which was like the tail wing of a giant dragon. It was steady and powerful, ensuring that the whole team had a safe way out.
In the entire huge team, no one was on foot.
Everyone was either riding in a car or riding a horse, led by horns and flags, like an awakened steel giant.
Start rolling forward in the direction of Yongcheng.
This is more than just a sacrificial ceremonial guard, it is also a huge war machine that can start quickly and move quickly.
In the morning light near the end of the year, the unparalleled majesty and power of the Qin Empire were displayed.
